AssetSecretConfig.title: AssetSecretConfig
AssetSecretConfig.description: A repository's own entries, added to the defaults (`defaults` counts them) in its scans.

BatchSummary.title: BatchSummary
BatchSummary.description: Progress worked out from the batch's real runs, with the estimated time left.

ChannelSaved.title: ChannelSaved
ChannelSaved.description: A saved channel and, for a webhook, its signing secret: shown this once.

ChannelTested.title: ChannelTested
ChannelTested.description: Whether the test delivery worked (a 200 also when it didn't), why, and the channels with their last result.

Channels.title: Channels
Channels.description: Never the channel's URL nor its signing secret: the host and what it is sent.

CveOverview.title: CveOverview
CveOverview.description: The local NVD copy: its size, per year and per day, the latest KEV additions and how its sync goes.

Exclusions.title: Exclusions
Exclusions.description: A repository's excluded paths, who set them last and why, and their history.

FindingOut.title: FindingOut
FindingOut.description: A finding as served: messages rendered in the reader's language, with its triage, fix and lifecycle.

GitHubStatus.title: GitHubStatus
GitHubStatus.description: What the GitHub App needs, whether it's connected, its installations and, read live, their permissions.

ImportCheck.title: ImportCheck
ImportCheck.description: What an import would create, counted, without creating it.

ImportedRun.title: ImportedRun
ImportedRun.description: The `sarif_import` run created for one tool, and what it changed in the asset's registry.

JiraBackfill.title: JiraBackfill
JiraBackfill.description: One rule's last backfill: issues queued and what became of them (`pending` still in the queue).

JiraBatches.title: JiraBatches
JiraBatches.description: The requester's recent queued selections, newest first.

JiraDestination.title: JiraDestination
JiraDestination.description:
Project + issue type + mapping. `fields`: the snapshot of the mapped fields (null for one migrated from the
single project of earlier versions, `legacy`, until it is saved again).

JiraExport.title: JiraExport
JiraExport.description: Each finding exported: an issue created, one that already existed, or why it failed.

JiraField.title: JiraField
JiraField.description: A create field. `type` says what Tamandua can put in it; `fillable` false: it can only be left empty.

JiraFieldValues.title: JiraFieldValues
JiraFieldValues.description: Allowed values of one field matching a search (lists too long for `allowed`).

JiraFields.title: JiraFields
JiraFields.description: The fields of an issue type's create screen and the mapping Tamandua proposes for them.

JiraQueued.title: JiraQueued
JiraQueued.description: A selection sent through the queue: progress of its issues, and the findings no rule routes (failed at once).

JiraRule.title: JiraRule
JiraRule.description: A routing rule; the last one (`default`) matches every asset. First enabled match wins.

JiraRulePreview.title: JiraRulePreview
JiraRulePreview.description: What a backfill of this rule would queue now (up to the backfill limit).

JiraStatus.title: JiraStatus
JiraStatus.description: The credential (never the token: its last four characters) and, for earlier panels, the default destination.

JiraVariables.title: JiraVariables
JiraVariables.description: What a mapping can use: Tamandua's variables (`source: tamandua`, or `{{key}}` in a template).

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: The model with the proposed components merged in, and which ones are new.

PullListing.title: PullListing
PullListing.description: `pulls_error` (and no pulls) when GitHub doesn't let the App read them: the settings can still be changed.

RegistryRow.title: RegistryRow
RegistryRow.description: A registry's saved credentials: the user and the last four characters of the token, never the token.

RunDetail.title: RunDetail
RunDetail.description: A whole run record, or a repository's state served in the same shape (`type` asset_state).

ScanPlan.title: ScanPlan
ScanPlan.description: What a scan will do, from the repository's real tree and the engines this installation can run.

SecretAllowlist.title: SecretAllowlist
SecretAllowlist.description: Regexes are matched against the detected secret; paths are globs relative to the repository root.

SlaDays.title: SlaDays
SlaDays.description: Days per severity; null means that severity has no due date.

SourcePage.title: SourcePage
SourcePage.description: A page of repositories (or the one asked for by `id`), with the connected accounts and providers.

ThreatCatalog.title: ThreatCatalog
ThreatCatalog.description: The models, the assets a component can link to, and the catalogs the editor offers.

ThreatModelView.title: ThreatModelView
ThreatModelView.description: A model with its threats (evidence from the linked assets' scans), their summary and the linked assets.

TotpStep.title: TotpStep
TotpStep.description: The password was right; the account has TOTP: send the code with this challenge to /api/auth/totp.

UserLink.title: UserLink
UserLink.description: The one-time link to hand to the person (invitation or password reset).

WatchConfig.title: WatchConfig
WatchConfig.description: A repository's watch settings (with who changed them last, once changed).

errors.description: When the error is about fields, one per field.
